If you’re after best value rather than just cheapest or priciest, here’s how to think about it on By Rotation:

For renting:

Look for weekly or monthly prices – these are discounted vs daily rates, so longer bookings give better value.
If it’s your first rental, you get 15% off automatically on orders over £20 (up to £15), which boosts value without chasing the lowest price.

For lending/pricing your item:

Use our suggested optimal pricing when you list – it’s based on price analytics to balance demand and income.
Set slightly discounted weekly and monthly rates to encourage longer, better-value rentals rather than just high daily prices.

For visibility vs cost (as a lender):

A Listing Boost (7 days for £5.99 or 14 days for £9.99) improves visibility in search and browse feeds and adds a “Boosted” badge.
It doesn’t guarantee rentals, but if your pricing and photos are already strong, boosting a hero item can be a cost‑effective way to get more eyes on it.

So, “best bang for the buck” on the app usually means combining fair, analytics‑backed pricing, discounted longer rentals, and, if you’re lending, selective use of Listing Boost on your most in‑demand pieces—rather than just going for the absolute cheapest or most expensive options.
